title: Nested sitemaps seem to 404 in Next.js 15

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/JamesSingleton/sitemap-issue

### To Reproduce

1. Start the app running `pnpm dev`
2. Go to `http://localhost:3000/resources/sitemap.xml/0` since in dev mode that's where it is supposed to live according to the [docs](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/generate-sitemaps)
3. You will get a 404
4. You can also do `pnpm build && pnpm start` and then go to `http://localhost:3000/resources/sitemap/0.xml` and you will get a 404 as well.

![Screenshot 2024-11-13 at 19 10 24](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bd2306ee-5e06-41fd-b7ec-acc01591389f)

### Current vs. Expected behavior

In Next 14 this worked just fine. However, after upgrading to Next 15 this no longer works.

### Provide environment information

```bash
Operating System:
  Platform: darwin
  Arch: arm64
  Version: Darwin Kernel Version 23.6.0: Mon Jul 29 21:14:30 PDT 2024; root:xnu-10063.141.2~1/RELEASE_ARM64_T6000
  Available memory (MB): 16384
  Available CPU cores: 10
Binaries:
  Node: 20.15.0
  npm: 10.7.0
  Yarn: 1.22.22
  pnpm: 9.13.0
Relevant Packages:
  next: 15.0.4-canary.11 // Latest available version is detected (15.0.4-canary.11).
  eslint-config-next: 15.0.3
  react: 19.0.0-rc-66855b96-20241106
  react-dom: 19.0.0-rc-66855b96-20241106
  typescript: 5.6.3
Next.js Config:
  output: N/A
```


### Which area(s) are affected? (Select all that apply)

Not sure

### Which stage(s) are affected? (Select all that apply)

next dev (local), Vercel (Deployed)

### Additional context

If you go to `localhost:3000/sitemap.xml` it will load that sitemap just fine
![Screenshot 2024-11-13 at 19 14 33](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/94e3fe6a-e462-4680-a2b6-5126741f95ae)

I even tried moving the `sitemap.ts` to just `app/resources/sitemap.ts` and going to `http://localhost:3000/resources/sitemap.xml/0` still does not load anything
